_comment: THE WISH CHAIN, end to end: a live Emiel / Peregrine Drake loop on board, no sink anywhere, and
Living Wish in hand. The correct line is wish -> Essence Depleter -> blink for the mana ->
cast it -> drain, and it is what the engine now plays: turn 4 casts Living Wish, blinks twice to
pay for the Depleter, deploys it, and turn 5 converts. Same board as
edf_blink_loop_cashes_drain.json with the Depleter moved from the battlefield into the
sideboard, so the pair isolates exactly what the wish costs -- and the answer is nothing beyond
the turn the Depleter cannot be cast and blinked in.
THIS BOARD READ win_turn 7 UNTIL 2026-09-04, and the cause was the HARNESS, not the engine.
--scenario hand-builds its GameState and never dealt the outside-the-game pool, so
players[0].sideboard was empty: Living Wish resolved and fetched nothing, every time, in every
fixture. The gap-two investigation recorded that 7 as 'the wish chain is a further hop' when
the wish had simply whiffed. GoldFishRunner::DealWishPool is now called from RunScenario as
well as SetupGame -- the StampDeckTraits hole one field over.
It also vindicates the tutor ranking (EldraziFlickerProvider::TutorCandidates, MTG_EDF_TUTOR_RANK
= 2), which scores a sink 100 when the loop is assemblable and a land 40: with a real pool the
wish takes Essence Depleter, exactly as that ranking intends. Nothing about the ranking changed
here; it had simply never been given a pool to rank.
Only win_turn is asserted -- which card the wish takes and how many times it blinks are searched
choices, and pinning them would break on unrelated search work.
